Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial replenishment request for concurrency soak

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We want to run a 72-hour concurrency soak to validate throughput and tail-latency under production-like traffic. Quick ask: can Redwood provision an additional 250,000 trial tokens for a time-boxed window so our infra team can run their load harness (concurrency peaks to ~1500 qps, 2k token average per request)?

High-level plan (attached poc-test-plan.xlsx):
- Start: 2026-07-01 00:00 UTC
- Duration: 72 hours
- Model variant: low-latency quantized variant requested (we'll pin on the Redwood catalog ID)
- Acceptance: 95th p99 latency under 300ms for 1-token generation, throughput validation completed

We can provide a signed mutual-action plan and limit callouts to a single model and region. Please let us know any guardrails you need (rate caps, IP allowlisting) and whether you need a short form of agreement.

Thanks —
Jessica Lin
Technical Lead, Integrations
Acme AI
Attachments: poc-test-plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Hi Jessica —

Appreciate the detail and the test plan attachment. This is a typical ask for POCs; happy to drive it through. Two quick clarifying q's before I loop in approvals:
1) Is the 250k estimate total token consumption across the 72h window or a per-day budget?
2) Any compliance constraints (SLA, data retention, IP) we should note up front?

If it's a single-window budget, I can escalate to Marissa for short-term replenishment. We usually set a hard expiration and a pinned model + region to limit blast radius.

If you confirm the total budget and the start time, I'll request an authorization and reply with the exact guardrails.

- Karthik
